Hamerkop EIMS

Electronic invoicing that stays connected to the business behind it.

Electronic invoicing affects more than the document sent to a customer. It touches transaction data, finance, reporting, approval, validation and the systems where the original sale or service is recorded. EIMS keeps those processes connected so invoicing does not become another isolated application inside the institution.

  • Electronic invoice and receipt workflows
  • Validation and status handling
  • ERP, finance, billing and POS integration
  • Transaction traceability and audit records
  • Operational and regulatory reporting
  • Controlled roles and access

Product portfolio

Platforms for different stages of institutional growth.

The Hamerkop portfolio covers enterprise operations, electronic invoicing, financial workflows, identity, integration and data.

  1. 01 ERP Family ERP Lite, ERP Business, ERP Enterprise and ERP for Government provide different levels of operational scope and control.
  2. 02 Hamerkop EIMS Electronic invoice and receipt processing connected with the systems that create, record and report the transaction.
  3. 03 Finance Suite A financial workflow platform for institutions managing collections, reconciliation and settlement.
  4. 04 Identity Institutional identity and access for verified users, controlled roles and secure application access.
  5. 05 Integrator A managed integration layer for applications, APIs and legacy environments.
  6. 06 Insight A reporting and analytics layer built around institutional data.
